Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to play a Digimon when this card attacks, can I suspend the played Digimon using this card's ?
Does this card's [All Turns] effect also trigger when this card itself would leave the battle area other than in battle?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can place all of those Digimon face-up at the bottom of your security stack. This card's [All Turns] effect affects all Digimon without having to choose them.
Card Q&A.q: If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when multiples of my Digimon with the [Royal Base] trait would leave the battle area at the same time, can I place all of those Digimon face-up at the bottom of my security stack?

Card Q&A.a: They become face-up security cards that remain revealed. Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.
Card Q&A.q: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?

Card Q&A.a: The check is performed with the card left revealed. Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.
Card Q&A.q: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?

Card Q&A.a: Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.
Card Q&A.q: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?

Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 [Royal Base] trait Digimon card from your face-up security cards with the play cost reduced by 8.
[All Turns] When any of your [Royal Base] trait Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, you may place those Digimon face up as the bottom security cards.
